[[Taskmaster Sadi-Belai]] is a [[Kournan military]] [[boss]] found in the [[Kodonur Crossroads]] [[mission]]. Killing her, along with [[Taskmaster Vanahk]] and [[Taskmaster Suli]], is the [[bonus]] objective of the mission.

==Notes==
*Regardless of whether or not she is killed during the mission, she will appear later in Vabbi as [[Commander Sadi-Belai]] with the same appearance and skills.
